description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the MembershipService class in the OrangeHRM HRM system, testing its methods for retrieving and deleting Membership entities, using mock dependencies and test fixtures.

classes.name: MembershipServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for MembershipService, containing setup and test methods for listing, retrieving by ID, deleting, and finding by name Membership entities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes MembershipService instance and loads test fixture data.

methods.name: testGetMembershipList
methods.description: Tests the getMembershipList method of MembershipService, ensuring it returns the correct list of Membership objects.

methods.name: testGetMembershipById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a Membership entity by ID.

methods.name: testDeleteMemberships
methods.description: Tests deleting multiple Memberships and returns the count of deleted records.

methods.name: testGetEducationByName
methods.description: Tests retrieving a Membership by its name.
